title: Add support for GameInput API on Windows

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body: - Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/8620 This PR enables GameInput API backend for SDL on Windows. I know we have already discussed this API [here](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/107967#issuecomment-3558603569), but in this PR we don't include GameInput headers/code, GameInput is downloaded with a script here, so it should be okay. This PR also removes unused backends in Godot (RawInput, WGI). DirectInput is not replaced by GameInput in this PR for devices with force feedback (racing wheels) since it's still used because of the haptics subsystem and https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/114642 , ~~and XInput is used as a fallback if GameInput is not enabled in the build (if GameInput is enabled, XInput backend is not compiled).~~ and XInput is used as a fallback for devices that aren't supported properly by current GameInput backend but are supported by XInput (arcade sticks, racing wheels, flight sticks, etc) (But I haven't tested these devices with GameInput, because I don't have them, that's why I decided to keep XInput). With this PR the detection of my Xbox One controller has changed: ```gdscript print(Input.get_connected_joypads()) for i in Input.get_connected_joypads(): print(Input.get_joy_name(i), ' ', Input.get_joy_guid(i), ' ', Input.get_joy_info(i)) ``` ``` [0] Xbox One S Controller 030058345e040000ea02000000006701 { "raw_name": "Xbox One S Controller", "vendor_id": "1118", "product_id": "746" } ``` Note that the GUID ends with `6700`, which means that this API is actually used. See the line 147 of `thirdparty\sdl\joystick\gdk\SDL_gameinputjoystick.c`: ```c elem->guid = SDL_CreateJoystickGUID(bus, vendor, product, version, manufacturer_string, product_string, 'g', 0); ``` TODO: - [ ] Should we use this API? - [ ] Check if this PR solves the issue of using more than 4 xbox controllers on Windows - [x] Create an installation script for the API - [x] Disable ~~XInput~~, RawInput+WGI joystick backends - [x] Scons argument - [x] ~~Still use XInput if GameInput is not enabled from scons~~ - [x] Patch file for SDL folder - [x] ~~Remove `Input.get_joy_info()["xinput_index"]` since XInput is no longer used~~ - [x] `#define HAVE_XINPUT_H 1` - [x] `get_deps_folder()` in `detect.py` is no longer needed - [x] Remove deleted files from the SDL update script - [x] `GAMEINPUT_GetDeviceSubtype`: subtype for GameInput controller when DirectInput backend is disabled - [x] Update according to https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/blob/release-3.4.x/src/joystick/gdk/SDL_gameinputjoystick.cpp and check for controller names - [x] Before doing fallback to DInput/XInput, check if their hints are enabled - [x] Update the Godot joypad output (name, GUID, `get_joy_info()`) above - [x] Fallback to DInput only if the device supports haptics? https://learn.microsoft.com/ms-my/gaming/gdk/docs/reference/input/gameinput-v2/interfaces/igameinputdevice/methods/igameinputdevice_isforcefeedbackmotorpoweredon-v2?view=gdk-2510 - [ ] `#define SDL_PLATFORM_WIN32 1` - [ ] Fallback to DInput for all non-gamepads, to fix the issue of a controller's ID being 1 instead of 0, for now - [ ] Use the code from SDL 3.4.12 TODO to fix regressions: - [x] Fix DirectInput mappings compatibility - [x] Make the driver read inputs if the app is unfocused - [x] Fallback to DirectInput for non-gamepad devices if both DirectInput joystick and DirectInput haptics backends are used - [ ] Check if this PR breaks Godot Windows apps under Wine or Proton - [ ] Check for FPS drops with Xbox controllers connected TODO for separate PRs: - [x] A PR for SDL with SDL code changes ( https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/pull/15173 ) - [ ] Godot Docs clarification - [x] Trigger rumble support ( https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/116214 ) - ~~Proper motion sensors support for GameInput backend?~~ Already done upstream - [ ] Proper reading of arcade sticks, racing wheels, and flight sticks - [ ] GameInput haptic backend, see also https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/gaming/gdk/docs/features/common/input/advanced/input-forcefeedback?view=gdk-2510 - ~~Steam virtual gamepad slot~~ Already done upstream - ~~Send the power information less frequently~~ Completely disabled upstream at the moment - ~~Support for GameInput v3~~ Already done upstream
